correctness.rationale: Explicit substitution yields conformal matrices with squared factors m±; stationary two-state occupation gives the almost-sure exponent. For all real q>0 the transfer formula is exactly a two-state positive matrix. Its unique Perron crossing p_q is proved using a strict rank-one eigenvalue derivative, and q↦p_q is strictly increasing via the hyperbolic-sine ratio. The Δ<1 boundary, rational q2/q4 witness and iid moment growth are derived without approximations; an actual standalone script passed 711 checks on the included file. Endpoints p=1 and p=p_q are handled separately, and finite numerical checks do not substitute for infinite proofs.

value.rationale: The concrete 2026 feedback algorithm exhibits a sharp, order-dependent barrier for robustness against time-correlated sign changes, including an exact safe almost-sure region where independent interaction changes necessarily increase mean-square error. Anti-persistence must exceed p2>1/2 for second-moment stability; p_q is strictly ordered for every positive real q. The rational case shows asymptotic norm decay and second-moment decay alongside fourth-moment growth, which is substantively useful for choosing risk guarantees rather than a cosmetic perturbation of a textbook stability estimate.
